purpose: Broaden the MouldMaster Book evidence pool across defects, energy, materials, cooling, weld lines, rheology, ejection, recyclate variability, fibre orientation and supplier-grade practice without changing learner-runtime content.

candidates.title: Warpage optimization on primary recycled polypropylene composites: investigating the effect of cooling time and injection temperature with machine learning and in-mold sensors
candidates.scale: 420 evaluated moulded parts across 21 process conditions; 20 samples per condition
candidates.rightsState: open-access article; verify exact reuse scope before extracting figures/tables
candidates.limitations: Reprocessed PP homopolymer with 40 wt% CaCO3 and one production geometry; prediction accuracy is case-specific.

candidates.title: Application of Artificial Intelligence-Integrated Six Sigma Methodology for Multi-Objective Optimization in Injection Molding Processes
candidates.rightsState: open MDPI article; raw production dataset reuse route must be checked separately
candidates.limitations: Severe class imbalance and one industrial control-panel line; predictive association is not physical root-cause proof.

candidates.title: Efficient injection moulding using active vacuum venting
candidates.rightsState: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 article; reference/derived commentary only unless reuse is allowed

candidates.title: Data-Driven Energy Consumption Modeling of Injection Molding Machine Modules
